description: Integrated summary of all evidence streams for KRT9 and the mechanistic model
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, time
from collections import Counter
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Rectangle

# ---- gather all evidence streams ----
seq=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P35527.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]; L=len(seq)
# AlphaFold
e=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P35527",timeout=120).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(e["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
pl={int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}
res=np.array(sorted(pl)); plv=np.array([pl[r] for r in res])
# gnomAD missense
q='query{ gene(gene_symbol:"KRT9", reference_genome:GRCh38){ variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ consequence hgvsp } } }'
vs=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":q},
                 headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=180).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
mpos=[]
for v in vs:
    m=re.search(r"p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Z][a-z]{2})$", v.get("hgvsp") or "")
    if m and m.group(1)!=m.group(3) and v.get("consequence")=="missense_variant": mpos.append(int(m.group(2)))
mpos=np.array(sorted(set(mpos)))
# ClinVar pathogenic
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
ids=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":"KRT9[gene]","retmax":500,"retmode":"json"},timeout=60).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    s=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"},timeout=90).json()["result"]
    recs+=[v for k,v in s.items() if k!="uids"]; time.sleep(0.4)
ppos=[]
for v in recs:
    sig=(v.get("germline_classification") or {}).get("description","")
    m=re.search(r"\(p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Za-z=]+)\)",v.get("title",""))
    if m and "athogenic" in sig and "Conflicting" not in sig: ppos.append(int(m.group(2)))
ppos=sorted(set(ppos))

KD=dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-0.9,-0.4,-0.8,-0.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(4,1,height_ratios=[1.05,1.0,1.0,1.5],hspace=0.55)
dom=[("head",1,152,"#e0e0e0"),("1A",153,188,"#b03030"),("L1",189,207,"#f7f7f7"),
     ("1B",208,299,"#8aa9c9"),("L12",300,322,"#f7f7f7"),("2",323,461,"#2f6f4e"),("tail",462,623,"#e0e0e0")]
def domtrack(ax,y,h):
    for nm,a,b,c in dom:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((a,y),b-a+1,h,color=c,ec="white",lw=0.8,zorder=3))
        if b-a>16: ax.text((a+b)/2,y+h/2,nm,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,zorder=4,
                           color="white" if c in("#b03030","#2f6f4e","#8aa9c9") else "black")

# panel A: AlphaFold
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0]); axA.plot(res,plv,lw=0.9,color="#333")
for a,b in [(153,172),(440,461)]: axA.axvspan(a,b,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.15)
axA.axhline(70,ls="--",color="k",lw=0.7); axA.axhline(50,ls=":",color="k",lw=0.7)
axA.set_ylim(0,105); axA.set_xlim(0,L); axA.set_ylabel("pLDDT",fontsize=9)
axA.set_title("a   AlphaFold confidence: folded rod (mean 87.5) between disordered arms (mean 36.4), p = 3.4e-99",
              loc="left",fontsize=10.5)
axA.set_xticklabels([])

# panel B: population missense density
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1]); win=40; cen=np.arange(win//2,L-win//2)
dd=np.array([((mpos>c-win//2)&(mpos<=c+win//2)).sum()/win for c in cen])
axB.plot(cen,dd,color="#3b6ea5",lw=1.6); axB.axhline(len(mpos)/L,ls=":",color="k",lw=0.9)
for a,b in [(153,172),(440,461)]: axB.axvspan(a,b,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.15)
axB.set_xlim(0,L); axB.set_ylabel("gnomAD missense\nper residue",fontsize=9)
axB.set_title("b   Population missense is depleted at both helix boundary motifs (0.32x by allele count, p = 1.1e-3)",
              loc="left",fontsize=10.5)
axB.set_xticklabels([])

# panel C: pathogenic lollipops on domain track
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[2]); domtrack(axC,0,0.5)
cnt=Counter(ppos)
for p,n in cnt.items():
    axC.plot([p,p],[0.5,0.62+0.1*n],color="#c0392b",lw=1.0,zorder=5)
    axC.plot(p,0.62+0.1*n,'o',color="#c0392b",ms=4+1.3*n,zorder=6)
axC.set_xlim(0,L); axC.set_ylim(-0.05,1.35); axC.set_yticks([])
axC.set_xlabel("residue position in KRT9 (P35527)",fontsize=9)
axC.set_title("c   21 of 22 ClinVar pathogenic alleles sit in those same motifs (14.2x enrichment, p = 5.2e-24)",
              loc="left",fontsize=10.5)

# panel D: mechanism schematic
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[3]); axD.axis("off"); axD.set_xlim(0,10); axD.set_ylim(0,3.2)
def box(x,y,w,h,t,c,fs=8.5,tc="black"):
    axD.add_patch(Rectangle((x,y),w,h,facecolor=c,edgecolor="#555",lw=0.9,zorder=2))
    axD.text(x+w/2,y+h/2,t,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=fs,zorder=3,color=tc)
def arr(x1,y1,x2,y2,style="-|>",c="#444",ls="-"):
    axD.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),arrowstyle=style,mutation_scale=12,
                                  color=c,lw=1.2,linestyle=ls,zorder=1))
box(0.1,2.2,1.7,0.7,"mechanical load\non palm and sole","#f2e2c4")
arr(1.8,2.55,2.5,2.55)
box(2.5,2.2,1.5,0.7,"YAP1 nuclear\nactivity","#dCE8f2")
arr(4.0,2.55,4.8,2.55)
box(4.8,2.2,1.3,0.7,"K16\ninduction","#dCE8f2")
arr(6.1,2.55,6.9,2.55)
box(6.9,2.2,1.5,0.7,"KRT9\ntranscription","#d8e8d8")
arr(8.4,2.4,8.9,1.9)
box(7.6,1.1,2.2,0.75,"K9 + K1 heterodimer\n→ tetramer → filament","#d8e8d8")
arr(7.6,1.5,6.2,1.5)
box(4.5,1.1,1.7,0.75,"disordered head\nbinds 14-3-3σ","#d8e8d8")
arr(4.5,1.35,3.6,1.35)
box(2.0,1.1,1.6,0.75,"YAP1 held in\ncytoplasm","#dCE8f2")
arr(2.8,1.85,2.9,2.2,style="-[",c="#c0392b")
axD.text(1.75,2.05,"negative feedback",fontsize=8,color="#c0392b",ha="center")
box(0.1,0.05,4.3,0.8,"EPPK mutation in helix boundary motif\n→ filament assembly blocked, keratin aggregates\n→ suprabasal cytolysis under shear","#f6d6d6",fs=8.5)
box(5.0,0.05,4.8,0.8,"→ 14-3-3σ scaffold lost, YAP1 goes nuclear\n→ hyperproliferation, failed differentiation, callus\n→ rescued by YAP1 inhibition in Krt9 null mice","#f6d6d6",fs=8.5)
arr(2.8,1.1,2.4,0.85,c="#c0392b"); arr(6.0,1.1,6.6,0.85,c="#c0392b")
axD.set_title("d   Mechanistic model: K9 is a load-bearing filament subunit that doubles as the cytoplasmic anchor for YAP1",
              loc="left",fontsize=10.5)
plt.show()
print("pathogenic positions:",ppos)
print("gnomAD missense n =",len(mpos),"| AlphaFold rod mean",f"{plv[(res>=153)&(res<=465)].mean():.1f}")
